name: sonicwall-mcp
description: Manage SonicWall firewalls via the SonicOS 7 REST API: objects, policies, interfaces, VPN, logs, and an explicit config commit step.
long_description: Structured access to the SonicOS 7 REST API. Every write is staged into the pending config and nothing takes effect until the separate sonicwall_config_commit tool runs. The server logs in itself (HTTP Basic over HTTPS), keeps the session in process memory, and releases the single admin slot on exit. A grounded generic request tool is checked against the vendor endpoint inventory. Not yet validated against hardware.

sonicwall_host.title: SonicWall host
sonicwall_host.description: Firewall hostname or IP (no scheme, no path). Required, no default: the base URL is the appliance itself.

sonicwall_username.title: SonicWall admin username
sonicwall_username.description: Dedicated least-privilege API admin, not the built-in admin, so audit entries are attributable.

sonicwall_password.title: SonicWall admin password
sonicwall_password.description: Sent only in the Basic Authorization header over HTTPS.

sonicwall_verify_tls.title: Verify TLS
sonicwall_verify_tls.description: Optional. Defaults to true. Set to false ONLY for an appliance still on its factory self-signed certificate; sonicwall_status reports it as a warning.

sonicwall_session_override.title: Session override
sonicwall_session_override.description: Optional. Defaults to false. When true, login and config-mode preempt whichever admin currently holds the session.
